title: Assurance Gaps in an Integrated Safety and Cybersecurity Case for an AI-Based Perception Component in Highly Automated Driving
description:
Supplementary material for a WAISE 2026 workshop paper and a SAFECOMP 2026 position paper. Builds an integrated GSN argument pattern that combines claims from ISO 26262, ISO 21448, ISO/SAE 21434 and ISO/PAS 8800 for an AI-based perception component in highly automated driving, a structure none of the standards prescribes, and reports the decision points and findings the integration exposes.

Includes the argument as machine-readable YAML, the five-step integration code, a generated traceability index from every claim to its clause or paper passage, an interactive view of the argument, and a notebook that follows one runtime anomaly through the clauses of each standard and finds that none assigns it to a concern.
